_comment: Copy to settings.json and edit. Every key is optional; missing keys fall back to the defaults shown here.
_pacing_comment: Anonymous quota is enforced per IP. These delays are deliberately slow — a block costs 15+ minutes, so waiting 3s per request is always cheaper than getting walled.
_proxy_comment: The one thing that actually raises the ceiling. Without proxies you are limited to what a single IP is allowed. Residential proxies work best; datacenter ones are often pre-blocked by Instagram.
_login_comment: Optional. Create the session yourself first with: instaloader --login=<username>. Never put a password in this file.
